verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents holding funds in 20 currencies with interbank-rate conversion. It also documents Global Accounts that receive local and SWIFT transfers into a Wallet, and agent tooling that reads balances. However, the explicit multi-currency holding claim comes from the Banking-as-a-Service page ("allow customers to hold"), not a first-party description of a founder's own single business account. missing for 10: explicit documentation that a founder's own business account holds multiple currency balances in one place, documentation of in-account balance management (viewing and moving balances across currencies), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can hold and manage balances in multiple currencies from one account

citations.quote: Allow customers to hold funds in 20 currencies, convert currencies at interbank rates
Global Accounts enable you to receive bank transfers into and authorize direct debit payouts from the Wallet.
Get the best possible market rate at the point of conversion or a guaranteed rate with a validity period
